title: Account and password help
heading: Resetting your password
text:
## Resetting your password

1. Go to the sign-in page and select "Forgot password".
2. Enter the email address on your account.
3. Open the reset email and follow the link.
4. Choose a new password.

The reset link is valid for 30 minutes. After that it expires and you need to request a new one. If you request several links, only the most recent one works.

If the email does not arrive within a few minutes, check your spam folder and confirm you entered the address you signed up with. For security reasons, support cannot set or tell you a password, and neither our team nor the AI assistant will ever ask for your current one.

title: Account and password help
heading: Updating your details
text:
## Updating your details

Sign in and open "Account settings" to change your name, email address, saved addresses, and communication preferences. Changing a saved address only affects future orders. To change the address on an existing order, contact support while the order is still "processing".

If you change your email address, we send a confirmation link to the new address. The change takes effect once you confirm it.

title: Account and password help
heading: Deleting your account
text:
## Deleting your account

You can ask us to delete your account by contacting support from the email address on the account. Account deletion requests are completed within 30 days. Before you ask, note that:

- Deletion is permanent. Your order history, saved addresses, and any active Plus membership are removed.
- Open orders, returns, and warranty claims should be finished first, because we cannot look up a deleted account.
- Gift card balances are not tied to your account. Keep the gift card emails and codes, since gift cards never expire.
- We keep some transaction records where the law requires it, such as tax records.

title: Account and password help
heading: Locked accounts
text:
## Locked accounts

After several failed sign-in attempts, the account locks for a short time to protect you. Wait 15 minutes and then reset your password using the steps above.

title: Changing your shipping address
heading: When a change is possible
text:
## When a change is possible

You can change the shipping address on an order only while its status is "processing". At that stage the package has not been labelled or handed to a carrier, so we can update the address before it leaves.

Be quick. Orders placed before 1 pm Mountain Time ship the same business day, so the processing stage can last only a few hours. Contact support as soon as you notice the mistake. The AI assistant is available 24/7 and can update the address on a processing order immediately. Have your order number and the full new address ready, including the unit or apartment number and the postal code.

title: Changing your shipping address
heading: When it is too late
text:
## When it is too late

Once the status is "shipped", we cannot change the address. The package is with the carrier and we cannot redirect it from our side. Your options are:

- Use the carrier's own tools. UPS, USPS, and FedEx each offer delivery holds or redirects on their tracking pages, sometimes for a fee. This is between you and the carrier, and we cannot guarantee it works.
- Ask someone at the old address to accept the package for you.
- If the package cannot be delivered, the carrier returns it to us and we refund the items once it arrives at our warehouse.

title: Changing your shipping address
heading: Limits on address changes
text:
## Limits on address changes

The new address must be within the United States or Canada, because those are the only places we ship. If a change moves the order from the United States to Canada, delivery takes 3-5 business days longer and duties are paid by the customer.

Changing the address does not change your shipping option or its price.

title: Changing your shipping address
heading: Updating your saved addresses
text:
## Updating your saved addresses

Editing the address book in your account only affects future orders. It does not update orders you have already placed. To fix an existing order, you must contact support while it is still processing.

title: Contact us and support hours
heading: Two ways to get help
text:
## Two ways to get help

Fernhill Outfitters support has two parts: an AI assistant and a team of human specialists.

The AI assistant is available 24/7, every day of the year, through the chat window on any page of our site. Human specialists work Monday to Friday, 8 am to 6 pm Mountain Time. They are closed on weekends and public holidays.

You can also email support@fernhill-outfitters.example.com. Emails are answered by specialists during the hours above.

title: Contact us and support hours
heading: What the AI assistant can do
text:
## What the AI assistant can do

The assistant can handle most requests from start to finish:

- Look up an order and its tracking.
- Cancel an order or change its address while the status is "processing".
- Check return eligibility and send a return label.
- Approve refunds up to USD 100.00 per order.
- Answer questions about shipping, warranty, Plus membership, and product care.

title: Contact us and support hours
heading: When a specialist takes over
text:
## When a specialist takes over

Some requests must be escalated to a human specialist:

- Any refund above USD 100.00 on a single order.
- Warranty claim assessments.
- Anything the assistant is not sure about, or when you ask for a person.

A specialist replies within 1 business day. If you contact us outside specialist hours, for example on a Saturday, the assistant records the details and the specialist reply arrives on the next business day. You do not need to repeat yourself, because the specialist sees the full conversation.

title: Contact us and support hours
heading: What to have ready
text:
## What to have ready

- Your order number. It starts with "FH-" and is in your confirmation email.
- The email address on your account.
- Photos, if the request is about damage or a warranty claim.

Never share your password or full card number with support. We will not ask for them.

Specialist hours of 8 am to 6 pm Mountain Time are 7 am to 5 pm Pacific, 9 am to 7 pm Central, and 10 am to 8 pm Eastern.

title: Item arrived damaged
heading: Report it within 14 days
text:
## Report it within 14 days

If something in your order arrives damaged or defective, report it within 14 days of delivery. Contact support with:

- Your order number.
- Photos of the damaged item.
- A photo of the shipping box, if the box was crushed, torn, or wet.

Photos are required. They let us approve your claim without asking you to ship anything first, and they help us file a claim with the carrier.

title: Item arrived damaged
heading: Your options
text:
## Your options

You choose how we fix it:

- A replacement, sent at no charge with the same shipping speed as the original order.
- A full refund to your original payment method, which takes 5-7 business days to appear after approval.

If the item is out of stock, we refund you instead. The AI assistant can approve refunds up to USD 100.00 per order on its own. Above USD 100.00, the request goes to a human specialist, who replies within 1 business day.

title: Item arrived damaged
heading: Sending the item back
text:
## Sending the item back

If the order value is under USD 50, you do not need to return the damaged item. Keep it, recycle it, or throw it away.

If the order value is USD 50 or more, we email you a free prepaid return label. Damaged and wrong items always get a free label, whatever your membership tier. You do not need to wait for the damaged item to reach us before a replacement is sent.

title: Item arrived damaged
heading: Final-sale items
text:
## Final-sale items

Damage on arrival is the one exception to the final-sale rule. A final-sale item that arrives damaged or defective qualifies for a replacement or a full refund, as long as you report it within the same 14 days.

If you find a fault later, it may be covered by warranty instead. Fernhill-brand gear has a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects, and tents and backpacks have 3 years. Shipping damage reported after 14 days cannot be claimed from the carrier, so please open your package soon after it arrives.

title: Exchanges and sizing
heading: We do not do direct exchanges
text:
## We do not do direct exchanges

Fernhill Outfitters does not offer direct exchanges. If you need a different size, color, or model, return the item for a refund and place a new order for the one you want. We handle it this way because stock moves quickly, and holding an item while another travels back to us often ends with the replacement selling out.

title: Exchanges and sizing
heading: The fastest way to swap
text:
## The fastest way to swap

1. Place the new order now, so the size you want is reserved.
2. Contact support with the original order number to start the return.
3. Send the original item back unused and with its tags.
4. Your refund goes to the original payment method and takes 5-7 business days to appear after approval.

The return must be inside your window: 30 days from delivery for Standard members, 60 days for Plus members. Items marked "Final sale" cannot be returned, so they cannot be swapped for another size either.

title: Exchanges and sizing
heading: Footwear size exchanges
text:
## Footwear size exchanges

Boots and shoes are the hardest items to size online, so a size exchange on footwear gets a free return label for everyone, Standard and Plus alike. Tell support that you are returning footwear for a different size and the flat USD 7.95 return fee is waived. You still place the new order yourself.

For other items, Plus members always get a free label, and Standard members pay the flat USD 7.95 deducted from the refund.

title: Exchanges and sizing
heading: Getting the size right
text:
## Getting the size right

- Each product page has a size chart with measurements in inches and centimeters. Measure yourself rather than relying on your size in another brand.
- For boots, measure your feet in the afternoon while wearing the socks you hike in. If you are between sizes, go up half a size.
- For backpacks, fit depends on torso length, not height. The size chart explains how to measure it.
- Try items on indoors, on a clean floor, and keep the tags on until you are sure.

title: Final-sale items
heading: What "Final sale" means
text:
## What "Final sale" means

Some items are sold as final sale. These are typically clearance items priced to sell through the last of a season's stock. A final-sale item cannot be returned or refunded once you have bought it, regardless of your membership tier. The 30-day Standard window and the 60-day Plus window do not apply to it.

title: Final-sale items
heading: How to spot a final-sale item
text:
## How to spot a final-sale item

The words "Final sale" appear in three places:

- On the product page, next to the price.
- In your cart, beside the item name, before you pay.
- On your order confirmation email, on the line for that item.

If an item does not carry the "Final sale" label in those places, it follows the normal returns policy. An order can contain a mix of both. In that case only the final-sale lines are excluded, and the other items can still be returned.

title: Final-sale items
heading: The one exception
text:
## The one exception

If a final-sale item arrives damaged or defective, you are covered. Report it within 14 days of delivery with photos of the damage and your order number. You can choose a replacement or a full refund. If stock has run out, which is common with clearance items, we will refund you instead.

Changing your mind, ordering the wrong size, or finding the color different from what you expected are not exceptions.

title: Final-sale items
heading: Other rules that do not apply
text:
## Other rules that do not apply

Final-sale and clearance purchases are not eligible for price adjustments, so if the price drops again after you buy, we do not refund the difference. We also do not offer direct exchanges on any item, so a final-sale item cannot be swapped for another size.

Fernhill-brand gear bought on final sale still carries its warranty against manufacturing defects. See the warranty coverage article for the terms.

title: Gift cards
heading: The basics
text:
## The basics

Fernhill gift cards are digital. They are delivered by email to the recipient you choose, with a 16-character code and the balance. Three rules apply to every gift card:

- Gift cards never expire. There are no inactivity fees and the balance does not shrink over time.
- Gift cards are not refundable for cash. Once bought, a gift card cannot be returned, and an unused balance cannot be paid out.
- Gift cards cannot be used to buy Plus membership. Plus must be paid for with a credit or debit card or PayPal.

title: Gift cards
heading: Using a gift card
text:
## Using a gift card

Enter the code in the "Gift card" field at checkout. The balance is applied to your order total, including shipping. If the order costs more than the balance, pay the rest with a card or PayPal. If it costs less, the remaining balance stays on the gift card for next time. You can apply more than one gift card to a single order.

To check a balance, sign in, open "Gift cards" in your account, and enter the code.

title: Gift cards
heading: Returns on gift card orders
text:
## Returns on gift card orders

Refunds go to the original payment method. If you paid with a gift card, the refunded amount is restored to that gift card, not paid in cash or to a bank card. If you split payment, each portion goes back where it came from. Keep the gift card email even after the balance reaches zero, in case you return something later.

title: Gift cards
heading: Lost codes and problems
text:
## Lost codes and problems

If you lose the email, contact support with the purchaser's email address and the approximate purchase date. We can resend the gift card to the original recipient address. We cannot replace a balance that has already been spent, so treat the code like cash and do not share it.

Gift cards bought during a sale do not qualify for price adjustments, because a gift card's value does not change.

title: Shipping to Canada
heading: Where we deliver
text:
## Where we deliver

Fernhill Outfitters ships only within the United States and Canada. We do not ship to any other country, and we do not accept orders addressed to freight forwarders or package-forwarding services. If you enter an address outside these two countries, checkout will not let you complete the order.

title: Shipping to Canada
heading: Delivery times to Canada
text:
## Delivery times to Canada

Orders to Canada use the same two shipping options as domestic orders, with extra transit time for the border crossing. Canada adds 3-5 business days:

- Standard: 4-6 business days plus 3-5 business days, so roughly 7-11 business days in total.
- Express: 2 business days plus 3-5 business days, so roughly 5-7 business days in total.

Shipping prices are the same as for United States orders. Standard is free over USD 75 and USD 6.95 otherwise. Express is USD 14.95. All prices on our site and all charges to your card are in US dollars. Your bank sets the exchange rate and may add a foreign transaction fee.

title: Shipping to Canada
heading: Duties and taxes
text:
## Duties and taxes

Duties and import taxes on orders to Canada are paid by the customer. They are not included in the total you see at checkout, and we cannot estimate or prepay them for you. The carrier usually collects them at the door or sends you a payment link before delivery. If you refuse to pay duties and the package is sent back, we refund the items once they reach our warehouse.

title: Shipping to Canada
heading: Returns from Canada
text:
## Returns from Canada

The normal returns policy applies: 30 days from delivery for Standard members and 60 days for Plus members, unused and with tags. Return labels are available for Canadian addresses. Duties you paid to the Canadian authorities are not something we can refund. You may be able to claim them back from the customs agency directly.

Tracking for Canadian orders may pause for a day or two while the package clears customs. This is normal and is not a sign of a lost package.

title: Lost or missing package
heading: Tracking has stopped moving
text:
## Tracking has stopped moving

Short pauses in tracking are normal, especially over weekends, in bad weather, or while a Canadian order clears customs. We treat a package as possibly lost when tracking shows no movement for 7 days. If your tracking has been stuck for 7 days, contact support with your order number and we will start a carrier trace.

title: Lost or missing package
heading: Tracking says "delivered" but you do not have it
text:
## Tracking says "delivered" but you do not have it

Carriers sometimes scan a package as delivered up to a day before it actually arrives. Wait 2 business days, and in the meantime:

- Check around your property: side doors, garage, porch, mail room, parcel lockers.
- Ask neighbors and anyone else at your address.
- Look for a delivery notice from the carrier.
- Confirm the shipping address on your order confirmation email.

If the package has not turned up after 2 business days, contact support.

title: Lost or missing package
heading: What we do next
text:
## What we do next

We open a trace with the carrier, which takes up to 5 business days. The carrier checks its scans, delivery location data, and the driver's notes. You do not need to contact the carrier yourself.

When the trace is finished, and the package has not been found, you choose one of two outcomes:

- A replacement shipped at no charge.
- A refund to your original payment method, which takes 5-7 business days to appear after approval.

Refunds above USD 100.00 per order are approved by a human specialist, who replies within 1 business day. The AI assistant can approve smaller refunds itself.

title: Lost or missing package
heading: If the package shows up later
text:
## If the package shows up later

If the original package arrives after we have sent a replacement or refund, please let us know. We will email a free prepaid label so you can send it back.

If the address you entered was incorrect, the carrier may return the package to us. An address can only be changed while an order is "processing", so please check it carefully at checkout.

title: Cancelling an order
heading: When you can cancel
text:
## When you can cancel

You can cancel an order only while its status is "processing". At that stage the order has not left our warehouse, so we can stop it and nothing is charged. Your card is charged when the order ships, which means a cancelled processing order normally results in no charge at all. If you see a pending authorization on your statement, it drops off on its own within a few business days.

Orders move quickly. An order placed before 1 pm Mountain Time ships the same business day, so the cancellation window can be only a few hours. If you need to cancel, contact support as soon as you can. The AI assistant is available 24/7 and can cancel a processing order right away.

title: Cancelling an order
heading: When you cannot cancel
text:
## When you cannot cancel

Once the status changes to "shipped", the order cannot be cancelled. We have no way to recall a package from the carrier. You need to wait for it to arrive and then return it under the normal returns policy: within 30 days of delivery for Standard members, or 60 days for Plus members, unused and with tags.

Please do not refuse the delivery. A refused package can take weeks to come back to us and delays your refund.

title: Cancelling an order
heading: How to check your status
text:
## How to check your status

Sign in to your account and open "Orders". Each order shows one of four statuses:

- Processing: being picked and packed. Can be cancelled.
- Shipped: handed to the carrier, tracking available. Cannot be cancelled.
- Delivered: marked delivered by the carrier.
- Cancelled: stopped before shipping.

title: Cancelling an order
heading: Cancelling part of an order
text:
## Cancelling part of an order

While an order is processing, we can cancel the whole order but not individual items. If you want to drop one item, cancel the order and place a new one with the items you want. Changing the shipping address follows the same rule and is only possible while the order is processing.

title: Order processing times
heading: The 1 pm cut-off
text:
## The 1 pm cut-off

Orders placed before 1 pm Mountain Time ship the same business day. Orders placed at or after 1 pm Mountain Time ship the next business day. Business days are Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays, so an order placed on Saturday or Sunday ships on Monday.

Some examples:

- Tuesday 11:30 am Mountain Time: ships Tuesday.
- Tuesday 2:15 pm Mountain Time: ships Wednesday.
- Friday 4 pm Mountain Time: ships Monday.

If you are in another time zone, convert first. 1 pm Mountain Time is 12 pm Pacific, 2 pm Central, and 3 pm Eastern.

title: Order processing times
heading: What happens while an order is processing
text:
## What happens while an order is processing

After you check out, your order has the status "processing". During this stage the warehouse picks your items, checks them, and packs them. This is the only stage where you can cancel the order or change the shipping address. Because same-day orders move fast, that window can be only a few hours long.

Your card is not charged while the order is processing. It is charged when the order ships.

title: Order processing times
heading: When the order ships
text:
## When the order ships

When the carrier collects the package, the status changes to "shipped" and you get an email with the carrier name and tracking number. Delivery estimates count from this ship date:

- Standard: 4-6 business days.
- Express: 2 business days.
- Canada: add 3-5 business days to either option.

title: Order processing times
heading: Possible delays
text:
## Possible delays

Processing can take an extra business day during major sales, when we may hold an order briefly to verify a payment, or when an item in your order needs a stock check. If your order has been "processing" for more than 2 business days, contact support with your order number and we will find out why.

Processing time is separate from shipping time. Choosing Express speeds up the carrier leg, not the warehouse cut-off.

title: Payment methods
heading: What we accept
text:
## What we accept

You can pay for a Fernhill Outfitters order with:

- Major credit and debit cards.
- PayPal.
- Fernhill gift cards.

You can combine one or more gift cards with a card or PayPal on the same order. We do not accept cash on delivery, checks, money orders, or bank transfers. All prices and charges are in US dollars, including orders shipped to Canada.

title: Payment methods
heading: When you are charged
text:
## When you are charged

Your card is charged when the order ships, not when you place it. While the order status is "processing", you may see a pending authorization on your statement. That is a temporary hold to confirm the card is valid, not a charge. If you cancel while the order is processing, the hold drops off on its own within a few business days.

Gift card balances are deducted as soon as you place the order. If the order is cancelled, the balance is restored to the gift card.

The USD 39 yearly Plus fee can be paid by credit or debit card or PayPal. Gift cards cannot be used to buy Plus membership.

title: Payment methods
heading: Declined payments
text:
## Declined payments

If your payment is declined, check the following:

- The billing address matches the one your bank has on file.
- The card number, expiry date, and security code are correct.
- The card has not expired and has enough available credit.
- Your bank has not blocked the transaction. Some banks flag a first purchase with a new retailer.

If the card is declined at the moment of shipping, the order stays in "processing" and we email you to update the payment method.

title: Payment methods
heading: Refunds
text:
## Refunds

Refunds always go to the original payment method and take 5-7 business days to appear after approval. We cannot refund to a different card or account.

For your security, never send full card numbers to support by chat or email. Our team and the AI assistant will never ask for them.

title: Fernhill Plus membership
heading: What it costs
text:
## What it costs

Fernhill Plus costs USD 39 per year. It renews once a year on the date you joined, and we email a reminder before the renewal. Everyone who is not on Plus is a Standard member, which is free.

title: Fernhill Plus membership
heading: What you get
text:
## What you get

Plus members receive four benefits:

- 60-day returns. You have 60 days from delivery to return unused items with tags, instead of the Standard 30 days.
- Free return labels. Every return ships on a free prepaid label. Standard members pay a flat USD 7.95 deducted from the refund.
- Free Express shipping on orders over USD 150. Express is 2 business days and normally costs USD 14.95.
- Early access to sales. Plus members can shop sale events before they open to everyone.

Plus does not change the final-sale rule. Items marked "Final sale" cannot be returned or refunded by any member unless they arrive damaged or defective. It also does not change refund approval: refunds above USD 100.00 per order still go to a human specialist.

title: Fernhill Plus membership
heading: Joining
text:
## Joining

Add Plus at checkout or from the "Membership" page in your account. You can pay with a credit or debit card or PayPal. Fernhill gift cards cannot be used to buy Plus membership. Benefits start right away and apply to orders placed from that moment on.

title: Fernhill Plus membership
heading: Cancelling and refunds
text:
## Cancelling and refunds

You can cancel Plus at any time from your account or by contacting support. What happens next depends on timing:

- Within the first 14 days, and no Plus benefit used: the USD 39 fee is refundable in full.
- Within the first 14 days, but a benefit was used, such as a free return label or free Express shipping: no refund, and your benefits stay active until the end of the paid year.
- After 14 days: no refund, and your benefits stay active until the end of the paid year.

Cancelling stops the next renewal. Approved membership refunds go to the original payment method and take 5-7 business days to appear.

title: Price adjustments
heading: How it works
text:
## How it works

If an item you bought goes on sale within 14 days of purchase, Fernhill refunds the difference between what you paid and the new sale price. The 14 days count from the date you placed the order, not the delivery date.

For example, if you bought a rain shell for USD 99.00 and it drops to USD 79.00 nine days later, you can ask for a USD 20.00 price adjustment.

title: Price adjustments
heading: The rules
text:
## The rules

- One adjustment per order. If two items on the same order go on sale, ask for both at the same time, because a second request on that order will be declined.
- The item must be the same product, size, and color you bought, and it must be in stock at the lower price when you ask.
- The lower price must be on our own site. We do not match other retailers.
- Final-sale and clearance purchases are not eligible. If you bought an item at a clearance price and it is marked down further, the difference is not refunded.
- The order must not be cancelled or already returned.

title: Price adjustments
heading: How to ask
text:
## How to ask

Contact support within the 14 days and give your order number and the name of the item. The AI assistant is available 24/7 and can check the current price on the spot. Price adjustments are refunds, so the usual approval limit applies: the assistant can approve up to USD 100.00 per order, and anything above that goes to a human specialist who replies within 1 business day.

title: Price adjustments
heading: How you are paid
text:
## How you are paid

The difference is refunded to your original payment method and takes 5-7 business days to appear after approval. We do not issue price adjustments as store credit or gift cards.

If you miss the 14-day window, the adjustment is not available. You can still return an unused item with tags within your return window and buy it again at the lower price.

title: Product care guides
heading: Down jackets
text:
## Down jackets

Down loses loft when it is dirty, so washing a down jacket properly makes it warmer, not weaker.

- Wash cold, on a gentle cycle, with a down-specific detergent. Regular detergent strips the natural oils from the down, and fabric softener makes it clump.
- Close all zippers and empty the pockets first.
- Tumble dry low with two or three clean tennis balls. The balls break up clumps and restore the loft. Drying takes a while, often two hours or more.
- Make sure the jacket is completely dry before you put it away, and store it hanging or loosely folded, not compressed in its stuff sack.

title: Product care guides
heading: Tents
text:
## Tents

- Never machine wash a tent. The agitation damages the waterproof coating and the seam tape. Clean it by hand with a sponge, cold water, and a mild non-detergent soap.
- Dry the tent fully before storage. Packing it away damp leads to mildew and a breakdown of the coating, which warranty does not cover.
- Shake out dirt and grit before packing, and use a footprint to protect the floor.
- Store it loosely in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight.

title: Product care guides
heading: Boots
text:
## Boots

- Re-waterproof your boots every 3-4 months of regular use, or sooner if water stops beading on the surface.
- Brush off mud after each hike. Dried mud pulls moisture out of leather and makes it crack.
- Clean the boots before applying a waterproofing treatment, and apply it while they are still slightly damp.
- Dry boots at room temperature with the insoles removed. Never put them next to a heater, fire, or in a dryer, because heat weakens the glue and shrinks leather.

title: Product care guides
heading: Why care matters for warranty
text:
## Why care matters for warranty

Fernhill-brand gear has a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects, and tents and backpacks have 3 years. Damage caused by washing or storing gear against these instructions is not a manufacturing defect, so it is not covered. Normal wear and tear is not covered either.

title: Refund approval limits
heading: What the AI assistant can approve
text:
## What the AI assistant can approve

Our support assistant is an AI agent that is available 24/7. It can look up your order, check whether it qualifies for a refund, and approve the refund itself when the amount is USD 100.00 or less per order. In those cases you normally get a decision in the same conversation, with no waiting for a person.

The assistant still applies every policy rule before approving anything. The order must be inside your return window (30 days from delivery for Standard members, 60 days for Plus members), the item must be unused with tags, and the item must not be marked "Final sale" unless it arrived damaged or defective.

title: Refund approval limits
heading: What needs a human specialist
text:
## What needs a human specialist

Any refund above USD 100.00 on a single order must be escalated to a human specialist. The assistant cannot approve it, split it into smaller refunds, or promise an outcome. It will collect the details, open the escalation, and tell you what happens next.

A specialist replies within 1 business day. Specialists work Monday to Friday, 8 am to 6 pm Mountain Time, so a request sent on Friday evening is picked up on Monday.

title: Refund approval limits
heading: Why the limit exists
text:
## Why the limit exists

Larger refunds get a second look from a person so that mistakes are caught before money moves. The limit is about who approves the refund, not whether you qualify. An eligible refund above USD 100.00 is still paid in full once a specialist signs off.

title: Refund approval limits
heading: After approval
text:
## After approval

Whoever approves it, the refund goes to your original payment method and takes 5-7 business days to appear. You receive a confirmation email with the amount and your order number. If a request is declined, the assistant or the specialist explains which rule applied, for example an expired return window or a final-sale item.

title: Refund timelines
heading: Where your refund goes
text:
## Where your refund goes

Every refund is sent to the original payment method used on the order. If you paid by credit or debit card, the money returns to that card. If you paid with PayPal, it returns to your PayPal account. If you paid with a Fernhill gift card, the amount is restored to the gift card balance. We cannot redirect a refund to a different card, a different person, or a bank transfer.

If you split payment between a gift card and another method, each portion goes back to where it came from.

title: Refund timelines
heading: How long it takes
text:
## How long it takes

Once a refund is approved, it takes 5-7 business days to appear on your statement. Business days are Monday to Friday and do not include public holidays. Approval is the starting point, not the day you asked for the refund or the day you dropped off a return.

You will get an email the moment the refund is approved. The email shows the refund amount and the order number.

title: Refund timelines
heading: Refunds that need a specialist
text:
## Refunds that need a specialist

The AI assistant can approve refunds up to USD 100.00 per order on its own, usually within the same conversation. Refunds above USD 100.00 are escalated to a human specialist, who replies within 1 business day. The 5-7 business day bank timeline begins after the specialist approves the refund, so larger refunds can take slightly longer end to end.

title: Refund timelines
heading: If your refund has not arrived
text:
## If your refund has not arrived

Count 7 full business days from the approval email before contacting us. Some banks show a refund as a reversal of the original charge rather than a new line, so check the original transaction date on your statement as well.

If nothing has appeared after 7 business days, contact support with your order number. We will confirm the refund date and reference so you can follow up with your bank or card issuer.

Standard members who used a paid return label will see the flat USD 7.95 return shipping fee deducted from the refund amount.

title: Return shipping labels
heading: Who pays for return shipping
text:
## Who pays for return shipping

What you pay to send an item back depends on your membership tier and the reason for the return.

You get a free prepaid label if:

- You are a Plus member. All your returns ship free.
- The item arrived damaged or defective.
- We sent you the wrong item.
- You are returning footwear to get a different size. This applies to everyone, Standard and Plus.

In every other case, Standard members pay a flat USD 7.95 for the return label. You do not pay this up front. It is deducted from your refund, so a USD 68.00 item returned by a Standard member results in a USD 60.05 refund.

title: Return shipping labels
heading: Getting your label
text:
## Getting your label

Contact support with your order number and the item you want to send back. Once the return is approved, we email a label as a PDF to the address on your account. Print it, or show the QR code at the carrier's counter if you do not have a printer.

Each label covers one package. If you are returning items from two different orders, you need a separate label for each order.

title: Return shipping labels
heading: Packing and drop-off
text:
## Packing and drop-off

Use the original box if you still have it, or any sturdy box or mailer. Remove or cover old shipping labels. Keep the item's tags attached, because returns must be unused with tags. Drop the package at any location for the carrier named on the label and keep the receipt until your refund arrives.

title: Return shipping labels
heading: Using your own carrier
text:
## Using your own carrier

You may ship a return at your own cost with any carrier, but we cannot reimburse that postage and we cannot trace a package we did not label. We recommend using the label we send.

Return labels are valid for shipments within the United States and Canada, the same regions we ship to.

title: Returns policy
heading: Return windows
text:
## Return windows

You can return most Fernhill Outfitters items for a refund. How long you have depends on your membership tier:

- Standard members: 30 days from the date of delivery.
- Plus members: 60 days from the date of delivery.

The window starts on the day the carrier marks your package as delivered, not the day you placed the order. If your order is still in transit, the clock has not started yet.

title: Returns policy
heading: Condition requirements
text:
## Condition requirements

To qualify for a return, the item must be unused and still have its original tags attached. Trying on a jacket or a pair of boots indoors is fine. Gear that has been worn on the trail, washed, or altered does not qualify for a standard return. If something failed during use, check our warranty coverage article instead, because a manufacturing defect is handled as a warranty claim rather than a return.

title: Returns policy
heading: What cannot be returned
text:
## What cannot be returned

Items marked "Final sale" (typically clearance items) cannot be returned or refunded. The only exception is a final-sale item that arrives damaged or defective. Gift cards and Plus membership fees are covered by their own rules, described in the gift cards and Plus membership articles.

title: Returns policy
heading: How to start a return
text:
## How to start a return

1. Have your order number ready. It starts with "FH-" and appears in your confirmation email.
2. Contact support through chat. The AI assistant is available 24/7 and can check eligibility right away.
3. Once the return is approved, you will receive a return shipping label by email. Plus members get a free prepaid label. Standard members pay a flat USD 7.95, which is deducted from the refund.
4. Pack the item with its tags and drop it off with the carrier shown on the label.

Your refund goes back to your original payment method and takes 5-7 business days to appear after approval. We do not offer direct exchanges, so if you need a different size or color, return the item and place a new order.

title: Shipping options and costs
heading: Standard shipping
text:
## Standard shipping

Standard shipping takes 4-6 business days. It is free on orders over USD 75. On orders of USD 75 or less it costs USD 6.95. The threshold is based on the item subtotal after discounts and before tax.

title: Shipping options and costs
heading: Express shipping
text:
## Express shipping

Express shipping takes 2 business days and costs USD 14.95. Plus members get free Express shipping on orders over USD 150. Express is a good choice when you need gear before a specific trip, but keep the processing cut-off in mind: only orders placed before 1 pm Mountain Time ship the same business day. An Express order placed at 3 pm on Friday ships on Monday and arrives on Wednesday.

title: Shipping options and costs
heading: Where we ship
text:
## Where we ship

We ship only within the United States and Canada. We cannot ship to other countries or to freight forwarders that re-export packages. Orders to Canada add 3-5 business days to the times above, and any duties or import taxes are paid by the customer. See the Canada shipping article for details.

title: Shipping options and costs
heading: Carriers and tracking
text:
## Carriers and tracking

We ship with UPS, USPS, and FedEx. The carrier is chosen by the warehouse based on your address and the package size, so you cannot select one at checkout. When your order status changes to "shipped", you receive an email with the carrier name and a tracking number. Tracking can take up to 24 hours to show its first scan.

- Business days are Monday to Friday and exclude public holidays.
- Delivery estimates start on the ship date, not the order date.
- Large orders may ship in more than one box. Each box has its own tracking number.
- Your card is charged when the order ships.

If tracking shows no movement for 7 days, see the lost or missing package article for what to do next.

title: How to file a warranty claim
heading: Before you start
text:
## Before you start

Check that your item is covered. Fernhill-brand gear has a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects, and tents and backpacks have a 3-year warranty, counted from the delivery date. Normal wear and tear is not covered. If you are not sure whether your problem counts as a defect, file the claim anyway and a specialist will assess it.

Every warranty claim needs two things:

- Photos of the problem.
- The order number, which starts with "FH-". You can find it in your confirmation email or under "Orders" in your account.

We cannot open a claim without both.

title: How to file a warranty claim
heading: Taking useful photos
text:
## Taking useful photos

Good photos speed up the decision. Please include:

1. One photo of the whole item.
2. One or two close-ups of the defect, in focus and in good light.
3. A photo of the product label or tag inside the item, if it has one.

For a leaking seam or a failed coating, a photo showing where the water gets in helps. Clean the item first so the defect is visible.

title: How to file a warranty claim
heading: Submitting the claim
text:
## Submitting the claim

Contact support through chat at any time. The AI assistant collects your order number, a short description of what happened, and your photos, then passes the claim to a human specialist for assessment. Specialists work Monday to Friday, 8 am to 6 pm Mountain Time, and reply within 1 business day.

title: How to file a warranty claim
heading: What happens next
text:
## What happens next

If the claim is approved, we repair or replace the item. If the same item is no longer available, we offer a comparable item or a refund of the price you paid. Refunds go to the original payment method and take 5-7 business days to appear after approval. If we need the item back for inspection, we send a free prepaid label.

If the claim is declined, for example because the damage is normal wear and tear, the specialist explains why and may suggest a repair option.

title: Warranty coverage
heading: What is covered
text:
## What is covered

Fernhill-brand gear comes with a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Tents and backpacks have a longer 3-year warranty, because they are built to last through many seasons. The warranty period starts on the delivery date of your order.

A manufacturing defect is a fault in materials or workmanship. Typical examples:

- Seams that come apart without being overloaded.
- Zippers that separate or lose teeth under normal use.
- Tent poles that crack at a joint during normal pitching.
- Waterproof coatings or seam tape that peel off early.
- Buckles, snaps, or strap stitching that fail.

title: Warranty coverage
heading: What is not covered
text:
## What is not covered

Normal wear and tear is not covered. Gear that gets used will show it, and that is not a defect. The warranty also does not cover:

- Worn-down boot soles, faded fabric, or pilling.
- Damage from accidents, misuse, fire, animals, or improper storage, such as mildew on a tent packed away wet.
- Damage from washing or drying against the care instructions.
- Alterations or repairs made by someone else.
- Products from other brands that we sell. Those carry the maker's own warranty, and we can point you to the right contact.

title: Warranty coverage
heading: Warranty versus returns
text:
## Warranty versus returns

A return is for unused gear with tags, within 30 days of delivery for Standard members or 60 days for Plus members. A warranty claim is for gear that has been used and failed because of a defect, within the 1-year or 3-year period. If your item arrived already damaged, use the damaged on arrival process instead, which must be reported within 14 days of delivery.

title: Warranty coverage
heading: Final-sale items
text:
## Final-sale items

Fernhill-brand gear bought as final sale still carries the same warranty. Final sale limits returns, not defect coverage.

To make a claim you need photos and your order number. See the article on how to file a warranty claim for the steps.
